name: Gnawing Dust
description: Hold a cloud of gnawing dust on a foe until the strength drains from every limb.

name: Eroding Veil
description: Draw a veil of eroded dust across the front so sight and sound grow faint.

name: Wearing Wave
description: Send a low wave of wearing sand across the ground that thins every stance it passes.

name: Sandgrip
description: Close a grip of packed sand round the target's body and tighten it with each breath.

name: Hollowing Dustfall
description: Let a heavy dustfall wear the ground hollow beneath a group until it gives way.

name: Boring Sand
description: Spin a drill of sand into a guard and bore a hole through its full thickness.

name: Ruin Grain
description: Strike with a single grain that has the wear of a thousand years packed into it.

name: Sandbound Fetters
description: Cast fetters of heavy sand over a group of foes and bind them together.

name: Reducing Maw
description: Open a maw of sand in the ground and grind down all that falls into it.

name: Unmaking Grain
description: Send a grain that wears body and qi alike and cannot be turned by any guard.

name: Swallowing Sand
description: Open the sand beneath the feet and swallow a blow whole into the earth below.

name: Erosion Sovereign
description: Rule the wearing of the whole field and set it upon every guard at once.

name: Ageless Erosion
description: Let the wear of ages fall on the field in one breath up to the full ceiling of the user's realm.

name: Grinding End
description: Grind the whole ground to fine dust across a reach no wider than the user's realm can command.

name: Hourglass Weight
description: Rest the full weight of a poured glass of sand on the target's frame.

name: Sandglass Veil
description: Pour a veil of sand before the foe's eyes that turns every shape upside down.

name: Pouring Wave
description: Pour a long wave of sand from the Core that rolls across the ground.

name: Glass Shackle
description: Close a shackle of poured sand on the target's ankles and let it harden to stone.

name: Hourglass Burial
description: Pour a whole glass of sand over a foe until only the head is left clear.

name: Narrow Fall
description: Drop a thread of sand from the narrow neck of the glass through the thickest guard.

name: Overturned Glass
description: Turn the glass over the field and let its whole upper chamber fall upon the foes.

name: Glass Sentence
description: Pass sentence with a falling stream of sand that holds a foe still as it mounts.

name: Last Grain
description: Drop the last grain of the glass into the target past any guard they hold.

name: Empty Hourglass
description: Turn the body into an empty glass that swallows a blow and pours it away below.

name: Emptying Glass
description: Empty the glass over the ground in one long pour that leaves nothing standing where it lands.

name: Final Pour
description: Pour the Core's whole sand upon the field in the school's founding act of ending.

name: Last Hourglass
description: Turn the last hourglass over the world below and let it fall to the ceiling of the user's tier.
